2607.27130.title: AgentMap: Joint Equivalence and Subsumption Discovery for Ontology Matching
2607.27130.paper_summary: Ontology matching (OM) has traditionally been formulated as either equivalence discovery or subsumption matching. The existing OM systems identify only one type of semantic correspondence and cannot simultaneously discover equivalence and subsumption mappings. In this paper, we introduce Hybrid Ontology Matching (HOM), a new OM task that unifies equivalence and subsumption discovery, and accordingly propose a Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent OM framework AgentMap that is implemented by a series of interdependent semantic decisions. Given a concept in the source ontology, AgentMap integrates semantic retrieval, hierarchical search, and collaborative multi-agent LLM reasoning to progressively explore the target ontology, identifying either the equivalent concept, if one exists, or the most fine-grained subsumer. We further extend four OM datasets for a HOM benchmark and evaluate AgentMap under hybrid, equivalence-only, and subsumption-only settings. Experimental results show that AgentMap achieves promising performance on the hybrid setting, and at the same time outperforms equivalence matching and subsumption matching baselines on the equivalence-only and subsumption-only settings, respectively.
2607.27130.paper_summary_zh: 本體匹配（OM）傳統上被定義為等價發現或包含關係匹配。現有的OM系統僅識別一種類型的語義對應，無法同時發現等價和包含關係映射。在本文中，我們介紹了混合本體匹配（HOM），這是一項新的OM任務，統一了等價和包含關係的發現，並相應地提出了一個基於大型語言模型（LLM）的多代理OM框架AgentMap，該框架由一系列相互依賴的語義決策實現。給定源本體中的一個概念，AgentMap整合了語義檢索、層次搜索和協作多代理LLM推理，逐步探索目標本體，識別等價概念（如果存在）或最細粒度的包含者。我們進一步擴展了四個OM數據集以建立HOM基準，並在混合、僅等價和僅包含的設置下評估AgentMap。實驗結果顯示，AgentMap在混合設置下達到了令人滿意的性能，同時在僅等價和僅包含的設置下分別超越了等價匹配和包含匹配的基準。
